cards.text: Report of a child left alone. Parents are unreachable. First step?

choices.text: Wait at the house for parents to return.

cards.text: Grandparents take the child. Mother arrives later, highly distressed.

choices.text: Calm her and assess the home situation.
Strictly inform her of the legal consequences.

cards.text: Mother arrives 3 hours later. She claims she had a work emergency.

choices.text: Validate her stress but set a safety plan.
Report her to the child protection registry.

cards.text: Police arrive. The neighborhood is watching. The mother is arrested.

choices.text: Try to mitigate the trauma for the child.
Let the legal system take over.

cards.text: Mother admits she is overwhelmed and has no childcare support.

choices.text: Suggest she finds a cheaper apartment.

cards.text: Mother becomes defensive and refuses to cooperate with the plan.

choices.text: Bring in a neutral family mediator.

cards.text: The child is in foster care. You must decide on a visitation plan.
Daycare is working. Mother is attending sessions regularly.
Progress is slow. The mother misses a counseling session.

choices.text: Home visit to investigate the barrier.

cards.text: Visits are emotional. The child wants to go home.
Mother disappears. The child is distraught. Case is stalling.
LOSS: Trust is destroyed. The family has moved into a high-conflict legal battle.
LOSS: Administrative delay caused the child to stay in foster care too long. Bonding failed.
The family is thriving. The social network is now fully supportive.

choices.text: Hand over the case to community care.

cards.text: Stability reached, but the family still relies heavily on you.
Mother is angry about the warning. Cooperation has ceased.
Reunification failed. The child remains in the system.
LOSS: Ethical breach. Your intervention caused more harm than the original situation.
CASE CLOSED: Final review of professional choices and social impact.
Alt Start: You receive a call from a school counselor regarding the child.

choices.text: Schedule a meeting with school first.

cards.text: Alt Start: The mother calls you herself asking for help.
The child refuses to speak to anyone and hides under a bed.
Bureaucratic delay: The funding for daycare is pending.
A relative comes forward offering to help full-time.

choices.text: Vet the relative and initiate transfer.
